mobbin:58c88fe6-2777-4b0f-8011-c816bff6d.summary: Admin picks Group from Create, configures a multi-invitee event type (duration, location, availability, invitee limit) in a side drawer, and creates it.
steps: Create menu: pick Group (1 host → multiple invitees)
New Meeting drawer — Group, invitee limit 2
Name webinar; Invitee limit section expanded
Invitee limit shown as Group with 2 invitees
Set duration to 1 hr
Expand Location (Zoom / Phone / In-person)
All options location list (Meet, Teams, Webex…)
Location set to Google Meet; Create ready
Availability drawer: 60 days / 4h notice + working hours
Custom weekly hours Mon–Fri blocks
Weekly Unavailable + date-specific hours
Availability finalize with Create
steal: Create menu states host↔invitee cardinality up front (One-on-one / Group / Round robin / Collective) — step 0
Invitee limit on Group = capacity per generated slot ("Group event with 2 invitees") — steps 1–3
Quick-create drawer + "More options" escape hatch while list stays visible — steps 1–7
Availability: rolling horizon + minimum notice + date-specific overrides — steps 8–11
avoid: Long multi-screen create with near-duplicate drawer states (duration/location/limit) before Create — high click cost for a simple capacity event
mobbin:58c88fe6-2777-4b0f-8011-c816bff6d.fit: Maps to flexi-custom capacity-per-slot and simple event types (scenario + seats); extends LearningSpace filtering with group max-attendees, not Excel import.

mobbin:5c1d65f9-65f5-48a9-b250-d04ba6f1a.summary: Admin creates a Round Robin event type, builds a rotating host pool, sets per-host locations and host-specific availability, then previews and saves.
steps: Create menu: pick Round robin (rotating hosts → 1 invitee)
New Meeting Round Robin — Add co-host / Create rotating host pool
Named Round Robin; pool rotating through hosts
Rescheduling prefs: reassign via round robin vs same hosts
Pool of 3 hosts; reschedule = same hosts
Per-host location list (No location) + Set location for all
Select location dropdown per host
Alex → Google Meet; others still empty
Mix locations: Meet vs Phone with phone number
Remaining hosts get Meet / phone
Availability Varied — schedules listed per host/timezone
Booking preview calendar + Save changes
steal: Round Robin Pool card with "Rotating through N hosts" — steps 1–4
Rescheduling preference: reassign through pool vs keep original hosts — step 3
Per-host location + "Set location for all" when location varies by host — steps 5–9
Availability "Set by host" with each host's hours by timezone — step 10
avoid: Per-host location mandatory before Create when pool >1 — blocks save until every faculty has a room/link
mobbin:5c1d65f9-65f5-48a9-b250-d04ba6f1a.fit: Direct pattern for faculty rotation across identical scenario sessions; keep collective/round-robin from baseline, map hosts→faculty and location→room.

mobbin:f9b02a84-c8b6-4997-aa01-1f7d9de77.summary: User opens Calendar sync, chooses Google/Outlook/Exchange/iCloud to connect, then configures which calendars are checked for conflicts vs where new events are written.
steps: Calendar sync: accounts + Check for conflicts vs Add to calendar
Select Calendar providers; iCloud help video modal
Connect list: Google, Outlook, Exchange, iCloud
Duplicate-connect error banner; sync config after connect
steal: Split "Check for conflicts" (read many) from "Add to calendar" (write one) — steps 0 and 3
Provider list includes Outlook and Exchange Server explicitly — steps 1–2
Account cap shown (1/6) next to Add Calendar Account — step 0
Inline error when calendar already connected — step 3
mobbin:f9b02a84-c8b6-4997-aa01-1f7d9de77.fit: Core outlook-sync pattern for Essentials: which calendars block room/faculty time vs where session invites are written; cheap to adopt on top of existing sync.
